button.label: Pretty Print
button.supertip:
Useful for untangling dense Excel formulas.
Applies consistent indentation, spacing, and alignment to chosen cells to improve clarity.
The opposite of Pretty Print is Minify.
Default: Pretty Print/Minify Selection Toggle

button.label: Minify Selection
button.supertip:
Reduce formula length by removing unnecessary spaces and line breaks in the selected range.
Helps optimize compactness while keeping formulas functional.

button.label: Minify Sheet
button.supertip: Reduce formula length by removing unnecessary spaces and line breaks for the active sheet.

button.label: Minify Workbook
button.supertip: Minify all formulas across the entire workbook by removing excess spaces and line breaks.

button.label: Pretty Print Selection
button.supertip:
Reformat formulas in the selected range with clear indentation and spacing.
Helps break down complex formulas for better readability and maintenance.

button.label: Pretty Print Sheet
button.supertip: Apply Pretty Print formatting to all formulas on the active sheet.

button.label: Pretty Print Workbook
button.supertip: Reformat all formulas in the entire workbook with consistent indentation and spacing.
